name: alpha-camera
description: Control a physically-connected Sony Alpha camera in natural language — connect, adjust settings, shoot, and review captured frames.
long_description: A stateful MCP server that wraps the Alpha Camera REST API (Sony Camera Remote SDK over USB). It holds one camera session so you can say things like "read my ISO", "shoot and show me the frame", or "set up for a bracket". Requires the Alpha Camera REST server (CameraWebApp) running locally and a supported Sony camera connected over USB.

base_url.title: Camera server URL
base_url.description: URL of the running Alpha Camera REST server. Start it separately with `crsdk start` (or run the CameraWebApp binary) before using these tools.
